fixtures.prompt:
Create a 2D planar DC magnetic model. All coordinates are in millimeters; out-of-plane depth is 10 mm.

Create an asymmetric C-shaped core using these polygon vertices in order:
(-15,-12), (10,-12), (10,-6), (-7,-6),
(-7,6), (6,6), (6,12), (-15,12).
Use linear relative permeability 1000 and place its label at (-12,0).

Add two rectangular winding cross-sections, both with relative permeability 1:
1. From (-5,-4) to (0,4), label (-2.5,0), +50 turns.
2. From (-22,-4) to (-17,4), label (-19.5,0), -50 turns.
Assign both to the same circuit carrying 1 A DC.

Use an enclosing air rectangle from (-40,-30) to (30,30), with A=0 on its boundary and air label at (20,20).
Use a global mesh size of 1 mm. Measure magnetic flux density at (3,0).

limitations: Public development fixtures, not an independent holdout or CAD-domain certification.
The current review receives rendered geometry AND the exact typed plan; this is not an image-only benchmark.
No native mesh is supplied. Geometry observations do not establish mesh validity, convergence or numerical accuracy.
Labels describe advisory matches/issues only and never authorize or block production model execution.
Errors and unmeasured cases are separate from correct answers; absent provider usage stays unknown, not zero.
Reversed turns are a typed-assignment discrepancy and may not be distinguishable from the image alone.
One call per model/fixture without retries; model variability and independent repetitions are not measured.
